routes.wedge: Build-to-drawing low-voltage panels for regional machine builders and factories.
routes.includes: Enclosure preparation, component mounting, wiring, labeling, and factory acceptance tests.
routes.excludes: In-house manufacture of breakers, PLCs, relays, or certified high-voltage switchgear.
routes.buyer: Machine builders, system integrators, and industrial plants with repeat panel designs.
routes.first_proof: Deliver three drawing-compliant panels that pass documented factory acceptance tests.
routes.source_note: Scope assumes bought-in certified electrical components and build-to-print assembly. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Supply repeatable terminal, busbar-support, connector, and protection-device subassemblies.
routes.includes: Kitting, crimping, torque-controlled assembly, continuity checks, and traceability.
routes.excludes: Primary manufacture of contactors, semiconductor devices, or complete high-voltage gear.
routes.buyer: Switchgear OEMs and panel builders outsourcing labor-intensive subassemblies.
routes.first_proof: Qualify one subassembly against buyer drawings, torque records, and incoming inspection limits.
routes.source_note: Opportunity is limited to qualified subassembly work using specified components. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Configure bought-in filter elements, housings, blowers, and controls into application-specific skids.
routes.includes: Mechanical assembly, ducting, controls integration, leak tests, and commissioning documentation.
routes.excludes: Manufacture of filter media, pressure vessels, or emissions-compliance guarantees without testing.
routes.buyer: Factories, process-equipment OEMs, and pollution-control contractors.
routes.first_proof: Commission one skid with measured pressure drop, airflow, leakage, and maintenance baseline.
routes.source_note: Configuration depends on validated air-quality and process-duty requirements. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Audit underperforming imported filtration systems and retrofit controls, seals, ducting, and consumables.
routes.includes: Site survey, performance measurement, retrofit engineering, installation, and maintenance contracts.
routes.excludes: Unverified emissions claims, filter-media manufacture, or replacement of pressure-rated vessels.
routes.buyer: Plants with aging dust collectors, gas filters, or recurring imported-spares delays.
routes.first_proof: Document a paid retrofit that improves pressure drop or uptime against a pre-work baseline.
routes.source_note: This service-led route validates demand before new equipment manufacturing. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Integrate imported and domestic components into rugged, buyer-qualified compute systems.
routes.includes: Component sourcing, assembly, firmware setup, burn-in, imaging, and service documentation.
routes.excludes: Semiconductor fabrication, motherboard design, or unsupported cybersecurity certification claims.
routes.buyer: Industrial automation OEMs, laboratories, and enterprises needing configured compute appliances.
routes.first_proof: Qualify a ten-unit pilot with thermal, burn-in, configuration, and field-support records.
routes.source_note: Local value comes from configuration, qualification, and lifecycle support rather than chip fabrication. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Recover, grade, rebuild, and warranty enterprise servers and industrial computers for secondary use.
routes.includes: Secure data erasure, diagnostics, component replacement, burn-in, grading, and limited warranty.
routes.excludes: Untraceable e-waste handling, counterfeit parts, or resale without licensed data sanitization.
routes.buyer: SMEs, schools, laboratories, and service providers accepting certified refurbished equipment.
routes.first_proof: Sell and track a 25-unit batch with erasure certificates, burn-in results, and warranty returns.
routes.source_note: Circular supply and documented data erasure are gating assumptions for this route. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Deliver buyer-specific multi-unit computing systems with networking, storage, imaging, and support.
routes.includes: System architecture, rack integration, software imaging, acceptance testing, and deployment support.
routes.excludes: Chip manufacture, proprietary operating-system development, or unaccredited security certification.
routes.buyer: Enterprises, public institutions, and OEMs procuring complete configured systems.
routes.first_proof: Complete one paid deployment against uptime, throughput, security, and acceptance criteria.
routes.source_note: Route targets integration and support value while retaining imported compute components where necessary. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Assemble qualified cells, BMS, protection, thermal elements, and enclosures for a narrow application.
routes.includes: Cell inspection, matching, pack assembly, BMS integration, end-of-line tests, and traceability.
routes.excludes: Cell manufacture, chemistry development, or packs sold without transport and safety qualification.
routes.buyer: Light-EV, stationary-storage, material-handling, and industrial-equipment OEMs.
routes.first_proof: Qualify a pilot pack through application cycling, abuse screening, traceability, and buyer validation.
routes.source_note: A narrow chemistry and application should be qualified before production scale-up. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Provide independent development tests, cycling, failure analysis, and documentation to pack integrators.
routes.includes: Instrumented cycling, environmental screening, BMS verification, teardown analysis, and test reports.
routes.excludes: Issuing statutory certifications without accreditation or performing uncontained destructive abuse tests.
routes.buyer: Battery-pack startups, vehicle OEMs, and industrial users lacking dedicated validation equipment.
routes.first_proof: Complete three paid test programs with calibrated equipment, repeatable methods, and buyer sign-off.
routes.source_note: Accreditation scope and hazardous-test containment must be separately validated. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Build application-specific power supplies, chargers, and converter cabinets from qualified modules.
routes.includes: Magnetics and module sourcing, PCB or cabinet assembly, firmware setup, burn-in, and load testing.
routes.excludes: Semiconductor fabrication, grid-code certification without testing, or unqualified high-power designs.
routes.buyer: Industrial-equipment, EV-infrastructure, telecom, and renewable-energy OEMs.
routes.first_proof: Deliver a controlled pilot that meets efficiency, thermal, EMC, and load-transient specifications.
routes.source_note: Entry assumes qualified power modules and application-specific integration rather than device fabrication. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Machine and finish a narrow family of shafts, housings, end shields, or lamination assemblies.
routes.includes: Process engineering, machining, balancing, inspection, traceability, and buyer-specific packaging.
routes.excludes: Complete motors, electrical-steel production, magnets, or safety-critical parts without qualification.
routes.buyer: Motor, generator, pump, compressor, and electric-drivetrain OEMs.
routes.first_proof: Achieve buyer approval on one part family through capability studies and endurance samples.
routes.source_note: Economics depend on a tightly bounded part family and repeat OEM volume. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Produce short-run molded or die-cut seals for maintenance and regional equipment OEMs.
routes.includes: Material selection, tooling, molding or cutting, dimensional inspection, and batch traceability.
routes.excludes: Aerospace, medical, or critical pressure-service claims without material and life validation.
routes.buyer: Pump, valve, process-equipment, automotive-aftermarket, and plant-maintenance buyers.
routes.first_proof: Qualify three repeat SKUs for dimensions, material properties, leakage, and service life.
routes.source_note: Start with non-critical applications and validated compounds before higher-liability service. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Serve low-to-medium-volume industrial buyers with custom boots, bumpers, diaphragms, and isolators.
routes.includes: Tooling, compound procurement, molding, trimming, inspection, and buyer-specific packaging.
routes.excludes: Tires, conveyor belting, regulated medical products, or proprietary compound development at entry.
routes.buyer: Industrial machinery, automotive-component, appliance, and construction-equipment OEMs.
routes.first_proof: Convert one imported molded component to a repeatable local part with buyer PPAP-style approval.
routes.source_note: A focused part family is assumed; economics should be validated against actual molds and rejection rates. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Produce configurable storage, workbench, shelving, and institutional furniture in repeat modules.
routes.includes: Sheet cutting, bending, welding, powder coating, assembly, packaging, and installation options.
routes.excludes: Commodity bidding without differentiated modules, bespoke architectural metalwork, or wood furniture.
routes.buyer: Factories, warehouses, laboratories, schools, offices, and institutional distributors.
routes.first_proof: Win a repeat order using tested load ratings, finish quality, lead time, and flat-pack economics.
routes.source_note: The route assumes modular designs and regional freight economics rather than one-off fabrication. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Roast, season, blend, and pack traceable nuts for brands and institutional buyers.
routes.includes: Ingredient receiving, roasting, seasoning, allergen controls, packing, testing, and batch records.
routes.excludes: Nut farming, branded retail launch, or unsupported health and export-compliance claims.
routes.buyer: Snack brands, retailers, food-service distributors, and export consolidators.
routes.first_proof: Produce three commercial batches that pass sensory, microbiological, allergen, and shelf-life checks.
routes.source_note: Food licenses, allergen controls, and buyer specifications must be validated for the selected market. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Manufacture shelf-stable specialty baked goods for regional brands with flexible batch sizes.
routes.includes: Recipe scale-up, baking, cooling, primary packaging, quality checks, and batch traceability.
routes.excludes: Fresh-store retail operations, unvalidated nutrition claims, or cold-chain bakery products at entry.
routes.buyer: Food brands, modern retailers, institutional caterers, and export-focused distributors.
routes.first_proof: Complete shelf-life validation and three repeatable paid batches for one anchor brand.
routes.source_note: Economics assume shelf-stable products, contracted demand, and validated food-safety controls. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Blend traceable species- and stage-specific feed concentrates for regional livestock clusters.
routes.includes: Ingredient testing, grinding or dosing, mixing, pelleting where needed, packing, and traceability.
routes.excludes: Veterinary drugs, therapeutic claims, commodity feed milling without formulation differentiation.
routes.buyer: Poultry, dairy, aquaculture, and livestock farms plus regional feed distributors.
routes.first_proof: Run a supervised farm trial showing consistent intake, growth, safety, and batch quality.
routes.source_note: Formulation, contaminant testing, licenses, and species-specific evidence require local validation. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Produce a narrow family of textile-upper sports shoes for brands needing flexible regional supply.
routes.includes: Cutting, stitching, lasting, sole attachment, finishing, inspection, and packing.
routes.excludes: Sole-compound manufacture, global performance certification, or branded consumer acquisition.
routes.buyer: Domestic footwear brands, retailers, institutional programs, and export buying houses.
routes.first_proof: Pass buyer wear, bond, flex, sizing, and social-compliance audits on a pilot order.
routes.source_note: Entry assumes buyer-provided specifications and a focused construction family. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Manufacture repeat leather-upper casual or formal styles for established brands and exporters.
routes.includes: Leather inspection, cutting, closing, lasting, sole attachment, finishing, and quality control.
routes.excludes: Tanning, luxury-brand development, safety footwear certification, or bespoke retail at entry.
routes.buyer: Footwear brands, department-store suppliers, and export buying houses.
routes.first_proof: Ship a pilot order meeting leather grading, fit, flex, adhesion, appearance, and audit criteria.
routes.source_note: Leather yield, rejection rates, and buyer audit costs must be proven on pilot styles. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Aggregate clean old corrugated containers from dense commercial clusters and sell graded bales.
routes.includes: Collection contracts, sorting, contamination control, baling, storage, and mill delivery.
routes.excludes: Paper pulping, municipal mixed-waste processing, or hazardous contaminated packaging.
routes.buyer: Paper mills and recyclers needing consistent domestic recovered-fiber feedstock.
routes.first_proof: Deliver three mill-accepted loads meeting moisture, contamination, bale-density, and grade limits.
routes.source_note: Economics depend on collection density, contamination control, and negotiated mill grades. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Sort commercial mixed-paper streams into repeat mill-ready grades with documented contamination.
routes.includes: Collection, manual or mechanical sorting, moisture checks, grading, baling, and dispatch.
routes.excludes: Household mixed-waste recovery, chemical de-inking, pulping, or hazardous paper handling.
routes.buyer: Paper and board mills seeking substitutes for imported recovered paper.
routes.first_proof: Secure repeat acceptance of segregated bales from two mills across three collection cycles.
routes.source_note: The business case must be validated by local composition studies and mill acceptance data. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Turn sourced raw veneer into matched, repaired, backed, and cut-to-size panels for interiors.
routes.includes: Drying, grading, stitching, jointing, backing, sanding, matching, and protective packing.
routes.excludes: Logging, primary peeling at entry, structural certification, or finished furniture manufacture.
routes.buyer: Panel processors, furniture OEMs, interior contractors, and architectural-material distributors.
routes.first_proof: Win repeat approval on matched sheets for moisture, thickness, bond, color, and yield.
routes.source_note: Yield, legal sourcing, and buyer aesthetic grades should be proven with actual veneer lots. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Convert qualified polyethylene film into printed or plain bags and liners for repeat B2B uses.
routes.includes: Printing, slitting, sealing, pouch or bag conversion, inspection, and batch traceability.
routes.excludes: Polymer resin production, multilayer barrier-film extrusion, or food-contact claims without validation.
routes.buyer: Food, chemical, textile, industrial, and e-commerce packaging buyers.
routes.first_proof: Qualify two repeat formats for seal strength, print, migration where applicable, and line performance.
routes.source_note: Route assumes film conversion first; extrusion and regulated-contact uses need separate validation. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Develop and mix a narrow portfolio of carbon-black-filled compounds for local molders.
routes.includes: Formulation control, weighing, internal mixing, milling, batch testing, and traceability.
routes.excludes: Synthetic rubber manufacture, tire compounds at entry, or performance claims without customer trials.
routes.buyer: Rubber molders, hose and belt manufacturers, seal makers, and industrial-component OEMs.
routes.first_proof: Qualify one compound at a buyer across three production batches and accelerated property tests.
routes.source_note: Formulation ownership, mixing controls, worker safety, and buyer validation are critical assumptions. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Form, fire, and finish low-volume technical or architectural ceramic components to buyer drawings.
routes.includes: Body preparation, forming, drying, firing, machining, inspection, and batch documentation.
routes.excludes: Semiconductor-grade ceramics, medical implants, or safety-critical insulators without qualification.
routes.buyer: Equipment OEMs, laboratories, kiln users, architects, and industrial distributors.
routes.first_proof: Produce a buyer-approved batch meeting shrinkage, porosity, dimensions, and thermal-cycle limits.
routes.source_note: Start with non-safety-critical geometries and validate body, firing, yield, and energy assumptions. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Integrate sensing, control, connectivity, enclosure, and firmware for one industrial workflow.
routes.includes: PCB assembly sourcing, firmware, enclosure integration, functional test, burn-in, and documentation.
routes.excludes: Semiconductor fabrication, broad consumer electronics, or functional-safety claims without certification.
routes.buyer: Machine builders, utilities, process plants, and industrial automation distributors.
routes.first_proof: Run a field pilot that meets functional, environmental, EMC, reliability, and support criteria.
routes.source_note: A single use case and controlled component baseline are assumed for initial qualification. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Engineer and assemble modular dryers, heaters, ovens, or temperature-control skids for one process niche.
routes.includes: Thermal design, bought-in burners or heaters, fabrication, controls, insulation, testing, and commissioning.
routes.excludes: Pressure vessels, hazardous-area systems, or process-performance guarantees without pilot data.
routes.buyer: Food, chemical, pharmaceutical, textile, and general manufacturing plants and OEMs.
routes.first_proof: Commission a paid unit meeting throughput, temperature uniformity, energy, safety, and uptime targets.
routes.source_note: Scope must remain within validated pressure, temperature, fuel, and process-safety boundaries. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Validate regional demand for cutting, edge finishing, drilling, coating, and certified tempering partnerships.
routes.includes: Demand mapping, sample finishing, outsourced tempering trials, dimensional inspection, and breakage testing.
routes.excludes: Unverified safety-glass certification, float-glass manufacture, or full tempering-line investment at entry.
routes.buyer: Appliance, building-products, solar, transport, and industrial-equipment manufacturers.
routes.first_proof: Secure buyer acceptance of pilot parts and a credible accredited testing and certification plan.
routes.source_note: Research-only route pending product-mix, certification, yield, energy, and buyer-demand validation. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Test traceable small-batch design-to-production services for established jewelers and exporters.
routes.includes: CAD, model making, casting, setting, finishing, hallmark coordination, traceability, and secure handling.
routes.excludes: Metal trading, consumer-brand launch, untraceable stones, or demand conclusions from gross imports alone.
routes.buyer: Established jewelry brands, wholesalers, designers, and export houses.
routes.first_proof: Complete a traceable paid capsule collection meeting yield, purity, finish, security, and delivery targets.
routes.source_note: Research-only because missing net-trade evidence prevents treating gross imports as a domestic-substitution opportunity. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Upgrade traceable crude glycerol into tightly specified technical blends before pursuing higher grades.
routes.includes: Feedstock testing, pretreatment, purification, concentration, blending, storage, lab QC, and traceability.
routes.excludes: Pharmaceutical or food-grade claims without validated purification, GMP, and regulatory qualification.
routes.buyer: Chemical formulators, personal-care manufacturers, resin makers, and industrial distributors.
routes.first_proof: Qualify one technical grade across three feedstock lots for purity, color, moisture, and contaminants.
routes.source_note: Feedstock assays, process yield, effluent controls, and end-grade certification require pilot validation. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.

routes.wedge: Extend imported and domestic harvester life with field diagnostics, localized wear parts, and crop-specific kits.
routes.includes: Fleet survey, diagnostics, reverse-engineered non-safety parts, retrofit kits, installation, and seasonal service.
routes.excludes: Complete harvester manufacture, engine or transmission rebuilding, or safety-critical parts without validation.
routes.buyer: Custom-harvesting contractors, farmer cooperatives, dealers, and large farms.
routes.first_proof: Operate ten retrofitted machines through one harvest with measured downtime, loss, and parts savings.
routes.source_note: Installed-base density, seasonal utilization, field durability, and warranty boundaries need local proof. Capital values are modeled validation/entry envelopes, never verified plant CAPEX.
